The incompatible components export the expected interface name but differ in
their type shapes. Tests must reject them before invocation.

`core-echo.wasm` is ABI-compatible but omits rule descriptors, so registry
admission rejects it. Accepted core fixtures are generated by
`core_fixture_test.go`, including a Ruff-shaped fixture exercising the bundled
backend path without generic shell selectors.
